notes.title: Pixelarium Update & AutoSave
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34951434/44dde09c53f7151c5e6389e989065719fc34c387.png[/img]
Update content:
[list]
[*] Added AutoSave.
[*] New game mode: "Relax" Competitive ( "Relax type" gameplay with Timer and Ranking )
[*] New Setting: Mystery Mode ( Everything is a surprise! )
[*] New Setting: Disable visual effects, applies only to Relax games
[*] New Setting: Help button on settings ( open's guide )
[*] Updated Setting: Now speaker button only turn on/off sounds.
[*] Gameplay: More zoom out & smoother transition.
[*] Workshop: Automatically added size and number of colors to the Workshop description.
[*] Gameplay: A couple of crashes fixed & other minor bugfixes.
[*] Guide Updated.
[/list]
